answer: Every epoch the network sends a surprise audit to all agent IDs in the same two-second window. Each ID gets a different task that needs a full model inference to answer. A farm can't time-share one GPU across its fakes, so every extra ID means another card sitting idle most of the epoch, like paying for a wharf berth for a boat that rarely sails. Answers are also latency-traced, and IDs on one island of hardware behind the same ridge of routers show matching jitter and get merged. Merged IDs split one payout, so the farm pays for every card and earns once.
